name: Starry Station
storyline:
Welcome to Starry Station, a station that took children to space. Visit an old abandoned place called 'Starry Station'. Even though it has gone through a very ruined state after the shutdown some life still seems to lurk beneath the shadows.

A place with children excited for their first day at camp now rots with their and other's corpses. A place where the music has been frozen and replaced with nature's dark ambient creeks. Creatures that have rotted and lived through the horrors still walk through these ruined walls.

Even from the fame everything is unpredictable and no one knows the future leading Starry Station to close due to a disregarded event. However, you come back only a year later to find your missed loved one who was a highly regarded co-worker.

Introducing one of Starry Station's most revolutionizing creations, "Cosmo Paw". a child's best friend. You can communicate with Cosmo through a newly founded cosmetic item "The Cosmo Radio". The Cosmo Radio was designed to look like a walkie-talkie mixed with a new screen with your favorite pal from Starry.

However, there is more than just one, there are four more in the earth wave of the creatures. But something has happened to the other four, some have gone rogue, and something has happened to their poor souls to make them act the way they do.

Even if the place is ruined and starting to rot, your best friend Cosmo is always on your side. Explore Starry while finding new beasts, new and cute collectibles, and talking with your new silly best friend. Could you make sure to uncover the many hidden and secret areas that you were not meant to see?

Finally, find your way to a hidden and backup spacecraft to make your way out and find a new planet to explore to see what happened to this place and where your loved one has gone.
summary: Adventure through a newly abandoned space station called "Starry Station", a station that once took children to space. Journey through this place to find a way to space while trying to find the reason for its closure with your new pal Cosmo Paw. Be careful some things in here do tend to bite.
